about: Explosive balance (frag grenade 'nade', plasma launcher 'nova', splashes). Same maths in index.html BLAST/blastBase/blastVis and server anticheat/blast.js. Distance is blast centre to the target's chest (feet + chest m). Damage = base(d) * visible fraction of 3 body points (head/chest/feet, weights w). No penetration: solid = 0.
